excelSummary.interpretation: Four of six pairs favorable, wide shared-host variation (including another ARM/HVF guest and desktop apps). Median ratio ~1.068 is exploratory, not a stable expected application improvement. Native instruction coverage rises from ~97.69% to ~98.41%; guest instruction deltas within pairs <0.04%. Direct RAM kernel establishes CALL-heavy improvement, not Rosetta or historical-CPU parity.
